name: Ferienwohnung Albert
beschreibung:
Enjoying a sunny, panoramic position in Schwoich, Ferienwohnung Albert welcomes guests with contemporary comfort and thoughtful amenities. The spacious apartment features a fully fitted kitchen, cosy living area, and a balcony with open mountain views.

The peaceful surroundings are ideal for scenic walks, cycling tours, and excursions to the Kaiser mountains or the historic fortress town of Kufstein.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Albert in Schwoich offers modern holiday living on the sunny plateau of the Kufsteinerland region.
